select mn.code mn, mn.shown mnd, mn2.code mn2, mn2.shown mn2d, cl.code cl, cl.shown cld, ag.code ag, ag.shown agd, cf.code cf, cf.shown cfd, sd.code sd, sd.shown sdd, sd2.code sd2, sd2.shown sd2d, dp.code dp, dp.shown dpd, al.code al, al.shown ald, jb.code jb, jb.shown jbd, pj.code pj, pj.shown pjd
from (select 1) o cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account x where code !~ '^UAT' order by (account_level <> 0), (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) mn cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account x where code !~ '^UAT' order by (account_level <> 0), (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 1 limit 1) mn2 cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from gl_chart_of_account x where code !~ '^UAT' order by (account_level = 0), (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) cl cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from gl_account_group x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) ag cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from gl_cash_flow_group x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) cf cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_side_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) sd cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_side_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 1 limit 1) sd2 cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_department_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) dp cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_allocate_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) al cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_job_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) jb cross join lateral (select code, x.code || case when coalesce(x.name_1, '') <> '' then '~' || x.name_1 else '' end shown from erp_project_list x order by (code !~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'), code offset 0 limit 1) pj
